description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds/milliseconds), ISO 8601, RFC 2822, or wall time into all common representations, identical to the Toolars timestamp-time-zone-converter web tool. Runs entirely locally; no network or filesystem access. Input and result enter the MCP client context and may be sent to its model provider.

outputTimeZone.description: One of UTC, local, America/New_York, Europe/London, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Tokyo, Asia/Seoul, Asia/Kolkata, Australia/Sydney.

source.description: Timestamp to convert, e.g. "1726848000", "1726848000000", "2024-09-20T12:34:56Z", or wall time "2024-09-20 12:34" (interpreted in outputTimeZone).

name: toolars_timestamp_convert
